events.title: Scottish barons date the Declaration of Arbroath
events.description: Scotland's nobles sent Pope John XXII a letter asserting the kingdom's independence from England and their right to depose any king who submitted to it. It is one of the most celebrated statements of medieval national identity.
events.html: Scotland's nobles sent Pope John XXII a letter asserting the kingdom's independence from England and their right to depose any king who submitted to it. It is one of the most celebrated statements of medieval national identity.

events.title: Jan van Riebeeck arrives at the Cape of Good Hope
events.description: Jan van Riebeeck reached Table Bay to set up a supply station for the Dutch East India Company. The outpost grew into Cape Town and began European settlement in southern Africa.
events.html: Jan van Riebeeck reached Table Bay to set up a supply station for the Dutch East India Company. The outpost grew into Cape Town and began European settlement in southern Africa.

events.title: Rama I takes the throne and founds the Chakri dynasty
events.description: The general Chao Phraya Chakri became king of Siam as Rama I and soon moved the capital across the river to Bangkok. His Chakri dynasty still reigns in Thailand today.
events.html: The general Chao Phraya Chakri became king of Siam as Rama I and soon moved the capital across the river to Bangkok. His Chakri dynasty still reigns in Thailand today.

events.title: First modern Olympic Games open in Athens
events.description: King George I of Greece opened the first modern Olympics at the Panathenaic Stadium. Revived by Pierre de Coubertin, the Games drew some 240 athletes from 14 nations.
events.html: King George I of Greece opened the first modern Olympics at the Panathenaic Stadium. Revived by Pierre de Coubertin, the Games drew some 240 athletes from 14 nations.

events.title: Peary and Henson claim to reach the North Pole
events.description: Robert Peary, Matthew Henson and four Inuit companions reported reaching the North Pole. Doubts over Peary's navigation mean historians still debate how close they actually came.
events.html: Robert Peary, Matthew Henson and four Inuit companions reported reaching the North Pole. Doubts over Peary's navigation mean historians still debate how close they actually came.

events.title: United States declares war on Germany
events.description: Congress approved President Wilson's request for war, provoked by unrestricted submarine warfare and the Zimmermann Telegram. American troops and resources helped tip the balance on the Western Front.
events.html: Congress approved President Wilson's request for war, provoked by unrestricted submarine warfare and the Zimmermann Telegram. American troops and resources helped tip the balance on the Western Front.

events.title: Gandhi breaks the salt law at Dandi
events.description: At the end of his 24-day march to the sea, Mohandas Gandhi picked up a lump of natural salt at Dandi, defying the British monopoly. The gesture launched a mass campaign of civil disobedience across India.
